In the end , Bhujbal Singh took Bela Bai along with him and started towards Pathri.

Bahu Raj Kunwar had agreed on the condition that she would go to jail next time. That ' s why this time she was bidding farewell to all the sisters by applying Kumkum ' s vaccine. Satyagrahi sisters and brothers all started picking.

slides.text: She used to go to the settlement of the cleaning workers and clean their children. If a sanitation worker does not allow children to study, then why should she explain to the children. Bela Bai thought like other satyagrahis that my son should also become a satyagrahi. When Bela Bai was in jail, sitting there, she took a vow that whether it is a son or a daughter, I will dedicate it to Gandhi .

Whenever Bela Bai remembered that day, the gleam of her eyes would show that it was the best day of her life. Phulkunwar Bai Phoolkunwar Bai was the mother of Manohar Lal Srivastava.
